content.title: Block normal access for locked_user
content.intent: Prove the locked persona receives a clear locked-state outcome and is not treated as a normal active session.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: eqp for the locked credential partition, auth for access restriction, and negative for the denied-login outcome. Web form and auth-gated profiles applied. No covering array was needed because locked_user is a distinct outcome-changing persona that must be separated from both valid and generic-invalid authentication.
